1) the clinical and laboratory data available in patients with type2 diabetes are insufficient to correctly identify a diabetic nephropaty; 2) a renal biopsy should be performed to identify a non-diabetic nephropaty in patients with type-2 diabetes; 3) the renal biopsy should not be performed in patients with type diabetes with a pure diabetic nephropaty.
